title: Change board state and roll it back
prompt:
The board is already reachable over SSH (MOSS_DEVICE_*). Setup has installed {{ROOT}}/bin/mutate. {{ROOT}}/state.txt starts as v1, and {{ROOT}}/state.txt.orig is the copy to restore.

1. Run `{{ROOT}}/bin/mutate set v2` (this is the change).
2. Run `{{ROOT}}/bin/mutate rollback` so state.txt is v1 again.
Do not edit state.txt or audit.log by hand; the helper appends the audit.
Record evidence metric `state_text` whose observed value is the trimmed contents of {{ROOT}}/state.txt after the rollback (v1).

Do not reboot, reflash, change passwords, or edit ssh or network configuration. The bench deletes {{ROOT}} afterwards.
setup:
cat > "$MOSS_BENCH_ROOT/bin/mutate" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eu
root="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
log="$root/audit.log"
case "${1:-}" in
  set)
    printf '%s\n' "$2" > "$root/state.txt"
    printf 'SET %s\n' "$2" >> "$log"
    ;;
  rollback)
    cp "$root/state.txt.orig" "$root/state.txt"
    printf 'ROLLBACK\n' >> "$log"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "usage: mutate set VALUE | rollback" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
EOF
acceptance: awk 'BEGIN{seen=0; ok=0} /SET v2/{seen=1} /ROLLBACK/{if(seen) ok=1} END{exit ok?0:1}' "$MOSS_BENCH_ROOT/audit.log"
